subject: Updates to package search on mran.revolutionanalytics.com

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Updates to package search on mran.revolutionanalytics.com
parts:
Hey folks,

We've just released an update to MRAN site at mran.revolutionanalytics.com with an even faster R package search tool. Click Packages > Explore Packages in the menu to get started.

We've also updated the package info pages to better highlight documentation (especially vignettes). Take a look at http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/packages/info/?knitr for a good example. The package search results also allow you to sort by the number of included vignettes, to help you find more easily packages with extensive documentation.

If you already have MRAN pages open, you may need to refresh your browser to see the changes. Let us know here if you see any issues or have suggestions for other improvements to MRAN!

Cheers,
# David Smith
